people_also_viewed.company:
I am a Transformation & Strategy Execution Leader with 25+ years of experience delivering large-scale programs across Business, Digital, Operations, and Strategy.

As Chief of Staff for Ipsen’s largest enterprise transformation, I have shaped governance models, steered financial performance, managed complex vendor ecosystems, and aligned cross-functional teams around shared strategic priorities. I thrive in environments requiring structure, resilience, and executive partnership — connecting vision to execution and enabling organizations to scale.

I bring deep expertise in program governance, operating model design, financial control, vendor & contract management, and multi-year transformation planning. Throughout my career, I have successfully led programs in the €20–50M range, mobilizing global teams of 150–200+ contributors and partnering with strategic companies and global integrators.

What motivates me:
• Turning complex transformations into structured, actionable roadmaps
• Building governance systems that sustain performance
• Creating alignment across Business, Digital, Operations, and HR
• Developing teams and empowering people through change

I combine analytical rigor with a collaborative leadership style, acting as a trusted advisor to executives and partners while fostering high-performing, resilient teams.
